answer: Locks are written down in ivory, expire in shale, and karst lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 64 aliases therefore needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2778 identities would post 3525 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
